title: social-studio publish history (S6)
description: Reference schema for store/data/history.json. Documents the contract; store/history.js is the ONLY module that reads/writes this file directly (spec completion condition #11) — no schema-validator dependency is used at runtime.

id.description: `{setName}#{platform}` — the upsert key. One entry per (set, platform) pair, never per item.

platform.description: e.g. youtube, instagram, x, facebook, naver, shorts, hatena

generatedAt.description: ISO8601 — when S1 produced this platform's content.

publishedAt.description: ISO8601 — set only when status becomes 'published'.

templateIds.description: Every templateId S1 used for this platform's items. Only counted toward exhaustion (rules/templateReuse.js) when status === 'published' — see spec section 0.

fingerprint.description: Opaque content marker (see lint/similarity.js's contentFingerprint) — never the raw generated text.
